components.description: Populated only when top-level status is FAILED to isolate the breaking element.

DeployStatusResult.description: Structural representation matching the GET /ssot/devops/deploy/{jobId}/status contract.

DeploymentLifecycleStatus.description: Deploy job lifecycle states (§5.6): the synchronous response is always CREATED; the job then advances to INPROGRESS and finally SUCCESS or FAILED, polled via `sf data-cloud deploy status`.

FailedComponentDetail.description: The single failing component isolated on a FAILED job (§5.7). Structured + actionable (component + reason) per the AI-era error principle — never a raw gack or "contact support".
